Let <MATH_0001> be homogeneous of degree <MATH_0002>. Recall that
<MATH_0003> corresponds to the
<MATH_0004>-module <MATH_0005> by Lemma <REF_0001>.
Thus we can define a canonical map
<MATH_0006>
which makes sense because <MATH_0007> is a trivializing
section of the invertible sheaf <MATH_0008>, see
Lemma <REF_0002> and its proof.
Since <MATH_0009> is quasi-coherent, this leads to a canonical
map
<MATH_0010>
via Schemes, Lemma <REF_0003>.
We obtain a global map if we prove that the displayed maps glue on overlaps.
Proof of this is omitted. We also omit the proof of the final statement.
